_comment: Google Drive sources for the 1D-nanotube pinning database. gdrive_fetch.py reads this; build_templates.py then merges them into nanotube_templates.npz. Each files[] entry has a local 'name' and the Drive 'id' (the token in a share link https://drive.google.com/file/d/<id>/view). Optional 'md5' triggers integrity re-download. Set 'folder_url' instead to mirror a whole shared folder (gdown backend). 'dest_dir' defaults to this data/nano_1D folder. NOTE: stage0 is the large synthetic set (~1 GB); alexandria_direct_1d.json is the real (DFT) set. The legacy alexandria_1d_nanotubes.pkl was retired in favor of alexandria_direct_1d.json.
